# Flowers In Action

> Flowers That Turn Feelings Into Moments

## Business Identity

- **Name:** Flowers In Action
- **Type:** Physical flower shop and WhatsApp-based flower delivery service
- **Location:** Plaza 24, B Block Bankers, Ground Floor, near DHA Phase 4, State Life Housing Society and Lake City Meadows, Lahore, Pakistan
- **WhatsApp:** +92 329 998 9911 (https://wa.me/923299989911)
- **Website:** https://flowersinaction.pk

## Services

- Fresh floral bouquets and hand-tied arrangements
- Floral boxes and floral & chocolate gift boxes
- Wedding flowers: bridal bouquets, floral jewellery, groom garlands, car and room decoration
- Money bouquets, gift baskets, crochet flowers
- Custom orders via WhatsApp
- Delivery across selected Lahore areas

## Service Areas

DHA Phase 3–5 Lahore, State Life Housing Society, Bankers Town, Lake City, Valencia Town, Wapda Town, Khayaban-e-Amin, Johar Town, and surrounding Lahore neighbourhoods.

## Ordering

This is not a traditional e-commerce site. Customers browse products on the website and order via WhatsApp. A 10% advance payment is typically required to confirm customised and delivery orders. No online card checkout.

## Product Categories

- Floral Bouquets
- Floral & Chocolate Bouquets
- Floral Boxes
- Floral & Chocolate Boxes
- Gift Baskets
- Money Bouquets
- Crochet Flowers
- Wedding Collection (bridal bouquets, floral jewellery, groom garlands, car decoration, room decoration)

## Current Offer

50% launch discount on listed products (subject to availability, season, customisation and delivery area).

## Policies

- Delivery availability and charges confirmed on WhatsApp
- Fresh flowers may vary by season; substitutions of equal value may be suggested
- Orders cancellable before preparation begins
- Refunds assessed case-by-case for damaged or incorrect items
